title: Beautify
description: Beautify is a dedicated aesthetic enhancement mod designed specifically for the Fps+ Cinematic project. While many visual mods come at the cost of performance, Beautify is built from the ground up to provide high-fidelity environmental details
body:
✨ Beautify (for Fps+ Cinematic)
Stop choosing between performance and aesthetics.

Beautify is a lightweight yet powerful visual overhaul mod crafted specifically for the Fps+ Cinematic environment. It serves as the bridge between raw technical optimization and high-end cinematic art. While Fps+ focuses on making your game run like lightning, Beautify ensures that every one of those frames is a masterpiece.

🎬 Why "Cinematic"?
Standard Minecraft can often feel flat or cluttered. Beautify introduces a curated set of visual enhancements that mimic high-end photography and cinematography principles—all while maintaining the blocky charm we love.

🚀 Key Features
Optimized Vistas: High-fidelity environmental tweaks that utilize modern rendering techniques to reduce "micro-stutter" during camera pans.

Dynamic Lighting Integration: Enhanced light-pathing that works seamlessly with Fps+ optimizations, providing deeper shadows and more vibrant sunsets.

Minimalist Detail: Adds subtle, non-intrusive decorative elements (like hanging plants, lattice work, and refined lanterns) that add depth to builds without overwhelming the GPU.

Texture Polish: Custom-mapped textures that react better to different times of day, making your world feel "alive" from sunrise to moonfall.

Camera-Ready: Specifically tuned for users who use Replay Mod or other cinematic tools, ensuring smooth LOD (Level of Detail) transitions.

🛠 Technical Compatibility
Beautify is designed to be modular and lightweight. It does not overwrite core engine files, making it highly compatible with:

Sodium / Iris (Standard in the Fps+ suite)

Replay Mod

Distant Horizons (Optimized for far-plane rendering)

📥 Installation
Ensure you have the Fps+ Cinematic base modpack or core mod installed.

Drop the Beautify .jar into your mods folder.

Enjoy a world that looks as fast as it feels.
